# Leverix name and availability evidence

**Selected name:** Leverix  
**Meaning:** leverage + vertex, a leveraged point of view on global market signals  
**Ticker:** `LVX` (presentation symbol for the testnet project)  
**Domain:** `leverix.top`  
**X username:** `@LeverixRh`  
**Pronunciation:** `LEV-er-iks`

Leverix is an independent project on Robinhood Chain Testnet. The name does not claim affiliation with Robinhood, a token listing, or financial performance.

## Final public identifiers

Checked on **17 November 2026** from this workstation. Results are point-in-time observations, not registrations, hosting evidence or legal clearance.

| Item | Method | Observed result | Remaining owner action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `leverix.top` | Public DNS resolution and an HTTP request | `A` records returned for the apex; `www` is a `CNAME` to `leverix.top`; port 80 answered with a placeholder lander page | Confirm registrar control, point DNS at the chosen host and enable HTTPS before publishing |
| `@LeverixRh` | [X profile URL](https://x.com/LeverixRh) | HTTP 200; the public profile exists and had no posts at check time | Apply the supplied display name, bio, avatar and banner; keep account recovery under owner control |

The website header and footer now link to [x.com/LeverixRh](https://x.com/LeverixRh), and the launch artwork prints `@LeverixRh` and `leverix.top`. The website, business plan, launch runbook and X package were updated to these identifiers on the same date.

## Earlier candidate checks

The record below documents the original naming run on **22 October 2026 at 00:38 Asia/Shanghai (21 October 2026, 16:38 UTC)**, using a real Chrome session and the CentralNic registry API. It is retained as history because `leverix.xyz` and `@leverix` are no longer the chosen identifiers.

| Item | Method | Observed result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `leverix.xyz` | CentralNic .xyz RDAP | HTTP 404; `Object not found` at check time |
| `@leverix` public profile | X profile URL | HTTP 404; `User Profile Not Found` at check time |

The registrar pages used as a second opinion (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Porkbun) returned captcha, empty or blocked responses during that session, so **premium or reserved status was not ruled out**. Availability can change immediately, and the RDAP/X checks do not replace registration or a trademark search. Raw evidence, including screenshots, is retained in `.rebrand/availability/`.

## Selection in this run

The candidate list was generated from the product's own keywords (index, perpetual, benchmark, leverage, vantage, quote and related terms), scored deterministically, then checked domain-first. `.xyz` is heavily registered for short dictionary and neo-Latin words: `clara`, `signa`, `always`, `claria`, `clario`, `claris`, `global`, `signia`, `signio`, `ticker`, `vanto`, `expora`, `markio`, `vantia`, `vantio`, `vantis`, `vantix`, `wallet`, `bencora`, `futures` and `levanto` all resolved to registered domains.

`expova` and `exposia` had unregistered domains but an existing X profile, so both were rejected. `leverin` had an unregistered domain but its X result was indeterminate. `leverix` was the first candidate for which both the registry and X returned a clear no-object result, and it was selected on that evidence rather than on preference. The final public identity was subsequently moved to `leverix.top` and `@LeverixRh`.

## Technical identity boundary

The display brand and ticker are presentation identifiers. Robinhood Chain Testnet (chain ID `46630`), contract addresses, RPC URLs, ABI data, transaction receipts and historical deployment records remain unchanged. The existing dUSD contract's immutable on-chain name is `LATQOR Demo USD`; this rebrand does not claim that deployed token was renamed.
